scenario: A stockout-censored zero-sales observation is treated as genuine zero demand.
expected_result: The zero-sales stockout is excluded from uncensored demand history; ground truth is used only to confirm that demand was positive.
detected_result: stockout_flag=True, units_sold=0, evaluation-only actual_demand=3; forecast was unchanged when the censored zero was removed.

expected_result: The deliberately invalid quantity is detected, while the normal engine output remains MOQ- and pack-size-compliant.

scenario: A previously eligible SKU is marked discontinued on the forecast origin date in an isolated master-data copy.
expected_result: The replenishment engine omits the discontinued SKU-store pair.
